changelog: Added Jellyfin 12.0 support, native Modern navigation links, Modern navigation and Legacy tab ordering and deep links, Custom Tabs and Jellyfin Enhanced compatibility, Jellyfin 12 auth, navigation and palette APIs, configuration reloads, and a warning for unsupported Jellyfin versions
description: The best way to discover and request Movies and TV Shows through Seerr directly in Jellyfin.
name: SeerrFin
overview: This plugin lets you add two extra tabs to your top bar, allowing you to discover new Movies and TV Shows, and easily request them in any quality profile you want.
